claims.text: The preserved Alibaba Model Studio lifecycle snapshot contains March 3 entries for Qwen Image 2.0 models in international and mainland-China regions, describing a model family that supports both image generation and editing; the snapshot also contains March-dated speech-recognition lifecycle entries.
claims.context: First-party lifecycle/index snapshot. Descriptions and capability comparisons are vendor-provided; this Evidence card does not independently reproduce image-quality or speech-recognition performance.

limitations.text: The retained source is a later lifecycle index snapshot rather than immutable March item pages. It verifies that the index records March-dated entries, but capability comparisons must remain attributed to Alibaba and later edits to the index cannot be assumed to reflect the exact March text state.
